summary: Sealed lay-by loop off Sir Samuel Griffith Drive, in forest, no buildings near.
reasons: Sealed lay-by clear of the traffic lane

drivers.seclusion: Forest on all sides with a small picnic clearing to the south-west. No buildings within 100 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lay-by about 3.5 m wide, with a grass island beside it; room for a van off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet road through the reserve; the lay-by sits apart from the lane.
drivers.convention: Looks like a designated lay-by beside a picnic area; no vehicles seen.

flags: Steep: about 8.5% mean in DEM, noisy locally
Lay-by is narrow, a van may take most of it
Many mapped gates nearby, none on the only access
sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees shade the road side in the morning.

best_section.where: Sealed lay-by loop on the south side of the road, at the ring
